creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Nothing notices when the checked-in Linux corpus (`corpus/herdr-0.8.0-linux/`) falls behind the macOS one. `./dev --corpus-linux` diffs a fresh Linux recording against macOS and never reads the checked-in Linux copy, which is how it drifted by six facts unnoticed until `77769b3` re-recorded it.

The tier could also diff its scratch recording against the checked-in copy and fail on a difference. That makes the `corpus-linux` CI workflow fail until somebody runs `probe --remote`, whenever a scenario is added or gains a fact. Whether that cost is worth it is the decision this card is for.
title: Nothing checks the checked-in Linux corpus for drift
